items.headline: Trump rejects new federal AI regulations, backs industry self-regulation

items.headline: Homeowners are sitting on record equity – and not using it
items.summary: U.S. homeowners have more housing wealth than ever before, thanks to fast-rising home prices over the last several years. But they aren't spending much of it.
